question: India's largest salt water lake is situated in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahanadi Delta**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahanadi Delta** is the location of India's largest salt water lake, Chilika Lake.
 
• Chilika Lake is a brackish water lagoon, spread over the Puri, Khurda and Ganjam districts of Odisha state on the east coast of India, at the mouth of the Daya River, flowing into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• It is the largest coastal lagoon in India and the second largest lagoon in the world.
 
• The lake is home to a number of threatened species of plants and animals. The lake region was designated as a Ramsar Site in 1981 to afford better protection.
 
• Chilika Lake is also an important habitat for the Irrawaddy dolphins.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chilika Lake** is a significant source of livelihood for the local fishermen and is also a popular tourist destination.
 
• The lake's ecosystem supports a rich biodiversity, including over 160 species of birds in the peak migratory season.
 
• The lake has been subjected to various conservation efforts to maintain its ecological balance and to support the local communities dependent on it.
 
• Chilika Lake is also known for its unique and diverse flora and fauna, making it a site of significant ecological and economic importance.
